hints.title: Prime Factor Sum Definition
hints.text: Decompose n into prime factors with multiplicity and compute their sum.

hints.title: Fixed Point Termination
hints.text: If the sum of prime factors equals n, the process reaches a fixed point and cannot decrease further.

hints.title: Trial Division Factorization
hints.text: Trial divide n by candidate primes starting from 2 up to sqrt(n) to accumulate prime factors.

hints.title: Prime Factor Sum Iteration Implementation

variables: k: number of replacement steps until fixed point
complexity.notes: Composite numbers decrease rapidly towards prime fixed points.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Precomputing large prime factor tables is overkill for single integer inputs up to 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Implements efficient prime factorization and handles fixed points such as 4 without infinite loops.
